philemon.1.p1.b1.text: Paul, a prisoner of Christ Jesus, and Timothy our brother, To Philemon our beloved fellow worker,

philemon.1.p1.b2.text: to Apphia our sister, to Archippus our fellow soldier, and to the church that meets at your house:

philemon.1.p1.b3.text: Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

philemon.1.p2.b4.text: I always thank my God, remembering you in my prayers,

philemon.1.p2.b5.text: because I hear about your faith in the Lord Jesus and your love for all the saints.

philemon.1.p2.b6.text: I take great joy and encouragement in your love, because you, brother, have refreshed the hearts of the saints.

philemon.1.p3.b7.text: So although in Christ I am bold enough to order you to do what is proper,

philemon.1.p3.b8.text: I prefer to appeal on the basis of love. For I, Paul, am now aged, and a prisoner of Christ Jesus as well.

philemon.1.p3.b9.text: I appeal to you for my child Onesimus, whose father I became while I was in chains.

philemon.1.p4.b10.text: Formerly he was useless to you, but now he has become useful both to you and to me.

philemon.1.p4.b11.text: I am sending back to you him who is my very heart.

philemon.1.p4.b12.text: I would have liked to keep him with me, so that on your behalf he could minister to me in my chains for the gospel.

philemon.1.p4.b13.text: … so that your goodness will not be out of compulsion, but by your own free will.

philemon.1.p5.b14.text: For perhaps this is why he was separated from you for a while, so that you might have him back for good—

philemon.1.p5.b15.text: … no longer as a slave, but better than a slave, as a beloved brother.

philemon.1.p5.b16.text: He is especially beloved to me, but even more so to you, …

philemon.1.p6.b17.text: So if you consider me a partner, receive him as you would receive me.

philemon.1.p6.b18.text: But if he has wronged you in any way or owes you anything, charge it to my account.

philemon.1.p6.b19.text: I, Paul, write this with my own hand. I will repay it …

philemon.1.p6.b20.text: … not to mention that you owe me your very self.

philemon.1.p7.b21.text: Yes, brother, … Refresh my heart in Christ.

philemon.1.p7.b22.text: Confident of your obedience, I write to you, …

philemon.1.p7.b23.text: … knowing that you will do even more than I ask.

philemon.1.p8.b24.text: In the meantime, prepare a guest room for me, because I hope that through your prayers I will be restored to you.

philemon.1.p8.b25.text: Epaphras, my fellow prisoner in Christ Jesus, sends you greetings, as do Mark, Aristarchus, Demas, and Luke, my fellow workers.

philemon.1.p8.b26.text: The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ be with your spirit.
